generation.text:
The weather pattern I'll explain is the formation and movement of a cold front. A cold front occurs when a mass of cold air moves into an area that is currently occupied by a mass of warm air. This is the cause.

When the cold air pushes into the warm air, it displaces it and forces the warm air to rise. As the warm air rises, it cools and loses its ability to hold as much moisture
